ideas.summary: Buy-side SBA capital-stack structuring engine for self-funded ETA searchers, built around the post-June-2025 SOP 50-10 8 full-standby seller-note + 10% equity-injection rules.

cross.ai_signal: Frontier LLM reasoning (Claude Opus 4.8 / Gemini 3.5 agentic era) over dense, recently-rewritten SBA SOP rules + a buyer's messy deal inputs.
cross.structural_signal: SBA SOP 50-10 8 (effective 2025-06-01) tightened seller-note/equity rules so deals are 'falling through'; runs into the $5T baby-boomer small-business transfer driving record ETA deal volume.

ideas.buyer: First-time self-funded searcher / ETA buyer under signed LOI on a $400k-$2M SDE service business (HVAC, plumbing, landscaping), at the financing-structuring stage.
ideas.trigger: SOP 50-10 8 in force since 2025-06-01; the SBA lender rejects the assumed seller-note structure inside the 30-60 day diligence/financing window and the LOI clock is running.
ideas.why_incumbents_cant: Lender-side tools (Aloan, LenderAI, Biz2x, iBusiness) organize/underwrite the file to protect the bank AFTER structure is set; retained buy-side advisors (Munera) are uneconomic for sub-$2M deals; ETA content/communities educate but don't generate a compliant structure + seller-negotiation artifact.

ideas.summary: AI tribal-knowledge / founder's-brain capture to document a retiring SMB owner's operations before they leave.
ideas.kill_reason: Saturated (Context Memo, MO Docs AI, WorkCell, SimplySOPs, oxmaint, Cohevo) AND is essentially YC Summer-2026's own 'Company Brain' RFS. Textbook one-step extension of an AI trend; everyone has it simultaneously.

ideas.summary: Black-box algorithmic-discrimination audit for non-tech AI deployers (e.g. property managers, regional lenders) triggered by Colorado SB24-205.
ideas.kill_reason: The why-now trigger no longer exists: Colorado SB24-205 was repealed and replaced by SB 26-189 (signed 2026-05-14) and never took effect. No live mandate = no urgency. Killed on the facts.

ideas.summary: AI SBA 7(a) loan packaging / underwriting automation (lender-side analyst layer).
ideas.kill_reason: Saturated lender-side: Aloan, LenderAI (iBusiness Funding), Biz2x, CRS Credit API all do SOP-50-10-7/8 file organization and underwriting. Wrong side of the table from the unserved buyer.

ideas.summary: Agentic vendor-oversight tool that discovers an RIA's real vendor stack and enforces the Reg S-P 72-hour breach-notification clause, sold to PE-backed RIA aggregators.
ideas.kill_reason: Covered by RIA-vertical incumbents already owning the compliance relationship: Venminder, Ncontracts, Smart-RIA, itSynergy, AdvisorLaw. Agentic discovery is a feature, not a wedge against entrenched vendors. Reg S-P deadline (2026-06-03) is real but the space is taken.

ideas.summary: RIA client-repapering / advisor-transition automation for PE roll-ups, to stop AUM leakage during post-acquisition account migration.
ideas.kill_reason: Saturated: Feathery, TradePMR Fusion SYNC, Skience all lead with 'end manual repapering' and AI-assisted transitions; a 2026 platform comparison already exists. No opening.

ideas.summary: Spanish-first compliance + certification copilot for tiny engineered-stone countertop fab shops, built around California's STOP Act (SB 20) phased silicosis regime (July 1 2026 training/attestation; July 2027 mandatory shop certification or suppliers can't sell to you).

cross.ai_signal: Multimodal, Spanish-first frontier models (Opus 4.8 / Gemini 3.5 agentic era) that can run a written exposure-control plan, deliver + log trigger-task training, track worker medical surveillance, and emit the annual Cal/OSHA attestation from a 5-person shop's messy photos and records.
cross.structural_signal: California STOP Act / SB 20 (signed 2025-10-13): bans dry-cutting, mandates training + annual written attestation from 2026-07-01, and a phased shop-certification regime where by 2027-07-01 distributors may only sell slabs to certified shops, tracked in a state public database. Cal/OSHA voted 2026-05-21 to advance >1%-silica artificial-stone rulemaking.

ideas.buyer: Owner of a 3-15 employee engineered-stone countertop fabrication shop in California (often a Spanish-first immigrant owner with no EHS staff), at the training/attestation stage.
ideas.trigger: 2026-07-01 training + annual written attestation requirement begins; the shop's slab distributor warns it must be state-certified by 2027-07-01 or lose the ability to buy slabs.
ideas.why_incumbents_cant: General EHS platforms (VelocityEHS, KPA, Cority, J.J. Keller) are priced and designed for mid/large firms with full-time EHS managers and English workflows; the only resources aimed at these shops today are static OSHA/Natural Stone Institute PDFs and one-off consultants. No software product encodes SB 20's brand-new, CA-specific, phased certification regime for a tiny Spanish-first shop.

ideas.summary: Slab-distributor certification-verification rail: the point-of-sale system that legally clears whether a stone shop is STOP-Act-certified before a distributor sells it slabs, with an audit trail against the state public database.

cross.ai_signal: Agentic verification + document-reasoning layer that reconciles a distributor's messy customer list against the state certified/non-compliant database and each shop's attestation status, and blocks or flags non-compliant sales in the order flow.
cross.structural_signal: Under SB 20, distributors are legally required to confirm a buyer shop's certification status before selling slabs (phasing to a hard bar by 2027-07-01), backed by a public state database of certified and non-compliant shops.

ideas.buyer: Compliance / sales-ops lead at a stone-slab distributor or importer (Caesarstone, Cambria, MSI, Arizona Tile, regional importers) selling into California, who becomes legally the enforcement chokepoint.
ideas.trigger: The 2027-07-01 supplier-certification bar plus 2026 database/attestation spin-up; distributors must build a defensible 'we verified before we sold' process now or risk liability and blocked sales.
ideas.why_incumbents_cant: Stone-industry ERPs and distributor order systems have no concept of a per-customer state silica-certification gate; generic compliance/KYB vendors don't touch a niche state public-health database. The verification rail sits between ~50-100 distributors and thousands of shops with built-in distribution.

ideas.summary: Voice-AI road-readiness coach that simulates the FMCSA two-step ELP roadside assessment (verbal interview + highway-sign ID) for immigrant owner-operator truckers and produces an 'ELP-ready' record.
ideas.kill_reason: Occupied. CDL Help already exists, purpose-built for the post-2025 two-step ELP assessment, in 10 languages with 13,000+ drivers; INFINITI is launching dedicated ELP training modules following the exact inspection flow. The why-now (FMCSA ELP out-of-service since 2025-06-25, permanent in the April 2026 CVSA criteria) is real, but the space is taken.

ideas.summary: Survey-evidence engine for hospitals that auto-assembles the 'data-driven staffing adequacy' packet for Joint Commission NPG 12 (effective Jan 2026) and ties staffing to performance-improvement root-cause analyses.
ideas.kill_reason: Occupied by incumbents extending. Kahuna Workforce already markets directly to NPG 12; symplr, QGenda and UKG own the hospital scheduling/acuity/competency data the evidence is built from, and accreditation-management is a crowded healthcare-IT space (Midas+, symplr). Large-hospital buyer is well served; no clean wedge.

ideas.summary: Multimodal mitigation-evidence dossier that turns a small commercial property owner's phone photos into the carrier-formatted wildfire/CAT resilience documentation packet to avoid a 2026 nonrenewal.
ideas.kill_reason: Occupied. ZestyAI Z-FIRE (carrier risk model), defensiblespacescore.com, Foothills Fire Block, FireRoofs and CompanyCam already do wildfire-mitigation documentation, and third-party services already 'build systems, complete hardening, and deliver documentation' working with agents/brokers. CA Safer-from-Wildfires 12-category discount framework is already mapped by these players.

ideas.summary: AI that finds a small company's qualifying domestic R&D and auto-prepares the retroactive Section 174 expensing election + amended 2022-2024 returns before the ~2026-07-06 OBBBA one-year window closes.
ideas.kill_reason: Saturated. The Section 174 / R&D-credit space is exactly where specialist tax-tech and firms already compete hard (alliantgroup, Strike Tax, ABGI, Cherry Bekaert, KLR, inkle), all of them actively marketing the OBBBA retroactive-expensing window. Wrong space to wedge into; deadline-driven but fully occupied.

ideas.summary: Compliance tooling for community banks / credit unions to meet CFPB Section 1071 (Regulation B) small-business-lending data collection, triggered by the 2026-06-30 effective date.
ideas.kill_reason: Why-now collapsed. The May 2026 final rule scaled 1071 back: the covered-institution threshold was raised tenfold to 1,000 originations (excluding most community banks/credit unions and all Farm Credit lenders), the small-business definition dropped to $1M revenue, and the single compliance date was pushed to 2028-01-01. Near-term urgency for the small-lender buyer was deliberately removed. Same failure mode as ts-0003 (verify the trigger is live).
